description: This Dart source file defines the SavedNewsDb class, which manages local database operations for storing, retrieving, updating, and deleting news articles in a Flutter application using the sqflite package. It includes database initialization, schema creation, and CRUD methods for handling NewsArticle objects.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: Manages local SQLite database operations for news articles, including initialization, insertion, deletion, and retrieval.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures the database is initialized; creates the database and schema if needed.

methods.name: _database
methods.description: Getter that returns the active database instance or throws if not initialized.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a NewsArticle in the database.

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a news article from the database by its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all news articles from the database, ordered by time descending.
